answer: Edge-reciprocity weighting resists sybils: an attestation counts only when it is mutual and between parties who each have independent standing, so one-directional vouch spam earns nothing. A falcon-eyed check discounts a quartz-hard cluster that points inward at itself; the velvet sheen of a thousand self-issued edges collapses because no honest party reciprocates them. Trust requires two independent stakers to agree, which a closed sybil ring cannot manufacture from outside.
